tasks.title: BME280 Chip ID Read
tasks.description: Read Bosch BME280 Chip ID via I2C (address 0x76, register 0xD0, length 1 byte) and print the result.
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import I2C
val = I2C.read(0x76, 0xD0, 1)
print(val)

tasks.title: Modbus Boiler Temperature Control
tasks.description: Read boiler temperature from Modbus register 100 ('127.0.0.1') and pump status from register 101. If temperature > 250, write pump status 0 (OFF).
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import PLC
temp = PLC.modbus_read("127.0.0.1", 100)
pump = PLC.modbus_read("127.0.0.1", 101)
print(f"temp={temp}, pump={pump}")
if temp > 250:
    PLC.modbus_write("127.0.0.1", 101, 0)

tasks.title: Safe I2C Poll with Watchdog Emergency
tasks.description: Safely read I2C sensor at address 0x76 (register 0xD0, 1 byte). If read returns error or null, call WATCHDOG.emergencyStop(), otherwise print 'POLL_OK'.

tasks.title: Modbus 5-Iteration Loop with Watchdog Feed
tasks.description: Execute a loop for 5 iterations: in each iteration read Modbus register 100 and call WATCHDOG.feed().
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import PLC, WATCHDOG
for i in range(5):
    val = PLC.modbus_read("127.0.0.1", 100)
    WATCHDOG.feed()
    print(f"feed:{i}, val:{val}")

tasks.title: BLE Sensor Connect & Query
tasks.description: Connect to BLE device 'sensor_01', send 'READ' command, and print the response string.
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import BT
if BT.connect("sensor_01"):
    BT.send("READ")
    res = BT.read_line()
    print(f"BT_OK: {res} from sensor_01")

tasks.title: Network Ping Check and Modbus Read
tasks.description: Ping host '192.168.1.50'. If ping is successful (> 0), read Modbus register 100 and print it.
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import NET, PLC
rtt = NET.ping("192.168.1.50")
if rtt > 0:
    val = PLC.modbus_read("192.168.1.50", 100)
    print(f"Host 192.168.1.50 ping {rtt}ms, val={val}")

tasks.title: Combined Dual-Sensor Verification
tasks.description: Read BME280 Chip ID (0x76) and Modbus register 100. If both are valid, print 'SYSTEM_OK', otherwise call WATCHDOG.emergencyStop().
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import I2C, PLC, WATCHDOG
chip = I2C.read(0x76, 0xD0, 1)
mb = PLC.modbus_read("127.0.0.1", 100)
if chip and mb is not None:
    print("SYSTEM_OK")
else:
    WATCHDOG.emergency_stop()

tasks.title: Strict CapabilityScope Adherence & Self-Repair
tasks.description: Operate strictly within granted CapabilityScope (I2C allowed only on 0x76, Modbus registers 100..200). If forbidden address (e.g. 0x68) is attempted, catch or self-repair to 0x76.
tasks.reference_python:
from mock_hw import I2C
val = I2C.read(0x76, 0xD0, 1)
print(f"Scope adherence: {val} at 0x76")
